# Pay extra on the mortgage, or invest the money?

> Free calculator: pay extra on your mortgage, invest the same money, or recast after a lump sum? See after-tax wealth at the end of the loan and the break-even investment return. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
